description.en: Original Anomalocaris-inspired tapered flexible marine swimmer with overlapping lateral flaps, paired curved frontal appendages and stalked eyes, three pairs of upturned tail blades and a simplified three-plate ventral oral cone. No broad horseshoe head shield or recolored earlier radiodont mesh. Spine/teeth counts and static pose artistic; no predation animation. Nominal length refers to the tapered body, excluding appendage/fan display extremes.
description.zh: 原创Anomalocaris启发海生渐细柔躯游泳体，侧叶叠接、成对弯前附肢与柄眼、三对上扬尾叶及简化三大板腹口；无宽马蹄头盾，不为旧奇虾类改色网格。刺齿数量和静态姿势属艺术选择，不作捕食动画；名义体长指渐细躯体，不计附肢/尾扇展示极值。

structural_scope.en: Original tapered flexible marine radiodont swimmer with lateral flaps, paired curved anterior appendages, seated stalked eyes and three raised tail-blade pairs. Three broad oral plates, microteeth/spines simplified; no predation animation or reused broad head-shield model.
structural_scope.zh: 原创渐细柔躯海生奇虾类，侧游泳叶、成对弯前附肢、自然柄眼与三对上扬尾叶。腹口简化三大板，细齿刺省简，无捕食动画或旧宽头盾网格复用。
